# Code of Conduct

[Project README](../README.md) | [English](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | [한국어](../docs/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.ko.md) | [日本語](../docs/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.ja.md)

## Our commitment

BuildPouch welcomes respectful participation from people of every background and experience level. Contributors, maintainers, and community members are expected to help keep project spaces safe, constructive, and focused on improving the software.

## Expected behavior

- Communicate with patience, honesty, and respect.
- Welcome different viewpoints and give actionable technical feedback.
- Take responsibility for mistakes and help repair their impact.
- Respect privacy, boundaries, and the confidentiality of security reports.
- Keep discussions relevant to the project and its community.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized conduct, personal attacks, deliberate intimidation, sustained disruption, impersonation, and publishing another person's private information without permission are not acceptable. Retaliation against someone who reports a concern in good faith is also prohibited.

## Scope and enforcement

This policy applies to repositories, issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and other spaces where someone represents BuildPouch. Maintainers may edit or remove content, close contributions, limit participation, or ban a participant when necessary to protect the community. Enforcement decisions should consider severity, repetition, context, and the safety of affected people.

Report conduct concerns privately to [dev-team@dreamyoungs.com](mailto:dev-team@dreamyoungs.com) with the subject `[BuildPouch conduct]`. Do not place sensitive details in a public issue. Reports will be handled as confidentially as practical and reviewed without retaliation.

This policy was informed by widely used open source community standards, including [Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/).
